variants.misreading: Premise check uses == True, so the integer 1 is accepted as a holding premise.
Refutation helper treats null as an explicit false, so a null admission_present enters the closed-world branch.
Input normalisation coerces the strings "true"/"false" into booleans before premise checks.
Execution guard requires only one of effect_source_accepted or effect_seen to hold instead of both.
Closed-world guards checked coverage before window finalisation, changing the reason when both fail.
A matching admission is credited before checking that the admission source is accepted.
Typo in the reason constant for an unattributed refusal.
Anything other than an observed effect is treated as a refuted effect, so an unknown effect goes down the refusal-credit path.
Effect-observation acceptance is only required for the no-effect branch, so an unaccepted observed effect still yields violated.
Defensive null check treats a present null state value as missing.
JSON comparison drops the boolean special case, so true equals 1 via numeric comparison.
List comparison checks membership rather than element-by-element order.
